zh.title: 颱風白海豚影響 華航取消上海航班 長榮星宇沖繩調整
zh.summary: 受颱風白海豚影響，中華航空宣布8月9日松山、桃園、高雄往返上海航班取消，桃園往返沖繩放大機型；長榮航空桃園往返沖繩放大機型為波音777-300ER；星宇航空安排8月9日、10日沖繩加班機協助疏運。航港局指出海運10航線共81航次停航。
body: 受到颱風白海豚影響，中華航空8月8日宣布，8月9日松山往返上海虹橋CI201/CI202、桃園往返上海浦東CI501/CI502及CI503/CI504、高雄往返上海浦東CI583/CI584航班取消；桃園往返沖繩CI120/CI121、CI122/CI123則放大機型。
長榮航空宣布8月9日桃園往返沖繩航班皆將放大機型為波音777-300ER，以利疏運旅客。
星宇航空指出，安排8月9日及10日沖繩加班機，台北－沖繩JX1870下午2時起飛，沖繩－台北JX1871下午5時50分起飛，協助旅客疏運。
航港局指出，8月9日海運10航線共81航次停航，其中基隆－馬祖、南竿福澳－福州琅岐、北竿白沙－福州黃岐、富岡－綠島、富岡－蘭嶼、後壁湖－蘭嶼、台南將軍漁港－澎湖東吉漁港及鹽埔－小琉球全部停航；布袋－馬公、東港－小琉球部分停航。
根據中央氣象署觀測，颱風白海豚8日下午5時中心位置在北緯26.9度、東經125.0度，即台北東北東方約410公里處，以每小時13轉17公里速度向西北西進行，近中心最大風速每秒35公尺，7級暴風半徑280公里。
本站統計紀錄顯示，颱風白海豚先前已影響國籍航空沖繩航班，中華航空曾於8月5日公布8月6日至8日飛沖繩航班異動、取消共14架次；星宇航空8月8日台灣往返沖繩航班全數取消，含原訂加班機JX1870與JX1871。

en.title: Typhoon Dolphin Disrupts Transport: China Airlines Cancels Shanghai Flights, EVA and StarLux Adjust Okinawa Service
en.summary: Typhoon Dolphin has prompted China Airlines to cancel Songshan, Taoyuan and Kaohsiung to Shanghai flights on August 9 while upgrading Taoyuan-Okinawa aircraft. EVA Air will upgrade Taoyuan-Okinawa to Boeing 777-300ER. StarLux Airlines has arranged extra Okinawa flights on August 9 and 10. The Maritime Port Bureau reported 10 sea routes with 81 sailings suspended.
body: Affected by Typhoon Dolphin, China Airlines announced on August 8 that Songshan-Shanghai Hongqiao flights CI201/CI202, Taoyuan-Shanghai Pudong flights CI501/CI502 and CI503/CI504, and Kaohsiung-Shanghai Pudong flights CI583/CI584 on August 9 are cancelled. Taoyuan-Okinawa flights CI120/CI121 and CI122/CI123 will be upgraded to larger aircraft.
EVA Air announced that Taoyuan-Okinawa flights on August 9 will all be upgraded to Boeing 777-300ER to facilitate passenger transport.

StarLux Airlines stated it has arranged extra Okinawa flights on August 9 and 10, with Taipei-Okinawa JX1870 departing at 2:00 PM and Okinawa-Taipei JX1871 departing at 5:50 PM to assist passenger transport.

The Maritime Port Bureau reported that 10 sea routes with a total of 81 sailings are suspended on August 9. Routes including Keelung-Matsu, Nangan Fukuang-Fuzhou Langqi, Beigan Baisha-Fuzhou Huangqi, Fugang-Green Island, Fugang-Orchid Island, Houbi-Orchid Island, Tainan Jiangjun Fishing Port-Penghu Dongji Fishing Port, and Yanbu-Xiaoliuqiu are fully suspended; Budai-Magong and Donggang-Xiaoliuqiu are partially suspended.

According to the Central Weather Administration, as of 5:00 PM on August 8, Typhoon Dolphin's center was located at 26.9 degrees north latitude and 125.0 degrees east longitude, approximately 410 kilometers northeast-east of Taipei, moving west-northwest at 13 to 17 kilometers per hour, with maximum sustained winds near the center of 35 meters per second and a radius of gale-force winds of 280 kilometers.

AVWIRE records show that Typhoon Dolphin had already affected Taiwan carriers' Okinawa services earlier. China Airlines had announced on August 5 flight adjustments from August 6 to 8 with 14 cancellations. StarLux Airlines cancelled all Taiwan-Okinawa flights on August 8, including the originally scheduled extra flights JX1870 and JX1871.
